verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a hosted SaaS product, so a published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack contains nothing about an uptime SLA, availability commitments, or a public incident status page; it covers only features, pricing, and the API.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
